label: Math
_note: Two rows, exactly as the treatment has it. A starting Rapport penalty you did not earn, from every prior math class these kids have had, and the line a student says out loud in every single unit. No new rule, no new meter, no new prop.

toast.title: From the third row
toast.body: "When are we ever going to use this." It is not a question and it is not rudeness. It is the sentence this room has been handed every year since fourth grade and today it is your turn to answer it.

missedCopy.default: Two people quietly stopped trying and you were writing on the board.

toast.body: You stop mid-derivation. The room finds itself. Somebody uses the silence to copy down step three.

flavor.report: You walked in nine points of Rapport down on a room you had never met, for things that happened to them in other people's classrooms.
